name: Telco NOC — Network Operations
description: Telecom NOC: alarms → correlation → one incident → topology traversal → service & customer impact → field work → comms → verified recovery. Multi-tenant, provenance-aware, AI suggestions with citations.

forms.name: Tenants
forms.description: Isolation boundary: one operator organization (or wholesale partner) whose data is invisible to other tenants.

forms.name: Resolver Teams
forms.description: Operator organization and resolver groups that own incidents, work and escalation.

forms.name: On-Call Assignments
forms.description: Who is on call for which team, role and region over which UTC interval. Drives assignment and escalation.

forms.name: Regions & Markets
forms.description: Region → Market hierarchy used for roll-ups, on-call routing and executive views.

forms.name: Sites
forms.description: A physical location (hub, CO, cell site, hut, customer premises) with address, coordinates and access/safety data for field work.

forms.name: Network Resources
forms.description: Every physical, logical and virtual network resource — fiber spans, ROADMs, ports, wavelengths, OTN/Ethernet links, routers, interfaces, circuits, RAN nodes, cells, power plants, network functions, paths. One table, typed by Resource Type (TMF639-style Resource with specialization).

forms.name: Topology Relationships
forms.description: Time-aware, provenance-carrying dependency edges. 'From' depends on 'To'. Includes resource→resource and service instance→resource edges so impact traversal is one graph.

forms.name: External Identifier Map
forms.description: Maps every identifier an OSS/BSS/monitoring system uses (NE:AID strings, hostnames+ifnames, vendor IDs, GIS IDs, billing IDs) to the stable internal ID. Alarm resource resolution reads only this table.

forms.name: Service Offerings
forms.description: Catalog of sellable services and their default SLA.

forms.name: Service Instances
forms.description: A deployed, customer-facing (CFS) or resource-facing (RFS) service. CFS instances are what customers buy; they depend on resources via relationships.

forms.name: Customer Subscriptions
forms.description: Links a customer account to a service instance under a contract + SLA. Consumer RAN coverage is modelled as aggregate segment subscriptions (Subscriber Count), never individual subscribers.

forms.name: Customer Accounts
forms.description: Billing/relationship account. Carries segment, tier, public-safety flag and comms preferences used for audience selection.

forms.name: Customer Contacts
forms.description: People to notify. PII — restricted visibility; masked in AI prompts and exports.

forms.name: SLAs
forms.description: Service level terms used to compute exposure, credits and breach ETA.

forms.name: Raw Alarm Events
forms.description: Immutable intake log: exactly one record per accepted source event (idempotency key), with the original payload for provenance and replay.

forms.name: Normalized Alarms
forms.description: One record per alarm condition instance (fingerprint while active). Repeats increment Occurrence Count instead of creating records.

forms.name: Correlation Groups
forms.description: A set of alarms explained by one root resource failure, with the reasoning and evidence that produced it.

forms.name: Metric Observations
forms.description: Normalized KPI / probe samples used to confirm impact and verify customer service recovery.

forms.name: Incidents
forms.description: The operational response record. One per correlated failure, not per alarm.

forms.name: Incident Timeline
forms.description: Append-only timeline: state changes, assignments, escalations, runbook steps (runbook execution), field updates, comms, verification, AI suggestions and decisions.

forms.name: Runbooks
forms.description: Versioned diagnostic/restoration procedures matched to resource types and alarm types.

forms.name: Problems & Known Errors
forms.description: Underlying cause across one or more incidents; becomes a Known Error when root cause + workaround are documented.

forms.name: Change Requests
forms.description: Planned work incl. maintenance window, risk and alarm suppression scope. Also records approval, deployment and rollback events in Timeline.

forms.name: Work Orders
forms.description: Actionable field work: where, what, access, safety, parts, completion criteria, evidence. Dispatch, assignment and site visit are tracked as states + timestamps on the order.

forms.name: Parts Inventory
forms.description: Spares by depot, with reserved quantity (inventory reservation). Reservations are referenced from work order Parts JSON.

forms.name: Impact Assessments
forms.description: Per incident × service instance × subscription: the impact class, the evidence, the topology path used, SLA exposure and recovery state.

forms.name: Customer Notifications
forms.description: A communication to an audience: draft → approval → delivery, with who approved and what was sent.

forms.name: Audit Events
forms.description: Who/what did what to which record, when and why — users, engine, workflows, integrations and AI.

forms.name: Integration Sources
forms.description: Every upstream/downstream system: mode, health, freshness. Drives the freshness banners in the UI.

forms.name: Reconciliation Conflicts
forms.description: Two sources disagree about a fact that matters for impact. Kept open until resolved; impact uses the policy value but flags lower confidence.

forms.name: AI Recommendations
forms.description: Every AI output with citations, fact/inference separation, confidence, and the operator's accept/reject decision (operator feedback).
